Health Stay one beat ahead. Get meaningful insights about your health just by wearing your Apple Watch SE 3. An innovative wrist temperature sensor enables deeper insights in the Vitals app and retrospective ovulation estimates in the Cycle Tracking app. You’ll also receive a daily sleep score and possible sleep apnea notifications. It’s never been easier to live in the know.

Track your daily health status in the Vitals app. Quickly see your overnight health data right on your wrist — including heart rate, respiratory rate, wrist temperature, and sleep duration — and get notified if your metrics are ever outside your typical range. 8 <picture class="overview-health-health-vitals positioned-media-element pin-offset static"> <source srcset="/v/apple-watch-se-3/b/images/overview/health/health_vitals__dor254sdht26_small.jpg, /v/apple-watch-se-3/b/images/overview/health/h

Cellular lets you stay connected even when you don’t have your iPhone nearby. 15 And with 5G capability, you can download apps faster and stream music or podcasts at the speed of go go go. 16
